description: Get available booking time slots for a scheduling link. Returns slots with start_at/end_at/duration/rank. SavvyCal REST: GET /links/{id}/slots.

duration.description: Slot duration in minutes to request (→ query param duration).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the slots, e.g. America/New_York (→ query param time_zone).

name: savvycal_get_link_slots
title: Get link slots
